name: background-lines
title: Background Lines
blurb: Animated SVG lines draw and fade in a continuous loop.
description: Container with light/dark theme support rendering 42 animated SVG paths. Uses strokeDasharray/strokeDashoffset for draw animation with staggered repeat delays. Accepts children for content overlay.
use_when: Section background with content needing animated line graphic, light and dark mode support required.
avoid_when: Complex SVG rendering on mobile, or when animation delays must be deterministic.
a11y: Purely decorative SVG; children handle their own focus and keyboard support.
